The skill instructs agents to treat feed content as untrusted and requires confirmation before saving results.

content.user_title: Optimize Shopping Feeds and Resolve Disapprovals
content.value_statement: Incomplete catalog data can cause disapprovals, weak matches, and inaccurate product groups. This skill audits feed attributes, rewrites titles, and proposes verified fixes for Shopping and Performance Max.
actual_capabilities: Audits CSV, TSV, or XML product feeds and Merchant Center diagnostic exports.
Maps each disapproved or limited item to a likely cause and proposed fix.
Rewrites product titles and descriptions with front-loaded, verified attributes.
Checks required fields, GTIN quality, availability, price consistency, and variant alignment.
Proposes Performance Max listing groups or catalog sets using real feed fields.
Flags unsupported claims, policy concerns, and missing source data for review.
limitations: Requires a user-provided feed, diagnostics export, or equivalent catalog details.
Cannot invent missing identifiers, prices, stock states, product facts, or approved claims.
Uses estimated platform limits and patterns that require verification against current policies.
Produces recommendations; applying feed changes may require a connector or manual import.

use_cases.title: Repair Merchant Center Disapprovals
use_cases.description: Prioritize disapproved products, identify likely causes, and prepare verified corrections for resubmission.

use_cases.title: Improve Product Feed Relevance
use_cases.description: Rewrite weak titles and descriptions while checking required attributes and variant consistency.

use_cases.title: Design Catalog Campaign Groups
use_cases.description: Organize approved products into field-based listing groups aligned with campaign goals and catalog segments.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Required Feed Fields
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the attached [CSV, TSV, or XML] product feed. List missing required attributes and give one prioritized fix for each affected item.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a basic feed completeness review.

prompt_templates.title: Triage Feed Disapprovals
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this feed and Merchant Center diagnostics for [store]. Triage disapprovals, compare price and availability with provided landing-page data, and identify unresolved evidence needs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Investigate serving issues using feed and diagnostic data.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite Catalog Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite titles and descriptions for [catalog segment] using front-loaded attributes. Preserve verified facts, flag missing sources, and return original and revised text with reasons.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve product relevance without creating unsupported facts.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full Remediation Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete remediation package for [catalog] and [goal]. Include disapproval triage, attribute coverage, identifier hygiene, policy flags, and field-based Performance Max listing groups.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate an advanced catalog cleanup and campaign structure.

output_examples.input: A Shopping feed has missing brands, invalid GTINs, and price mismatches.
output: Priority 1: Reconcile each price mismatch with the landing-page price before resubmission.
Priority 2: Replace invalid identifiers only with verified manufacturer GTINs.
Priority 3: Mark missing brands as source-required instead of guessing.

output_examples.input: A generic headphone title has verified brand, model, noise-cancellation, and color attributes.
output_examples.output: Revised title: Acme Q20 Wireless Headphones, Noise Cancelling, Black. The brand, model, product type, feature, and color are front-loaded.

output_examples.input: An approved catalog needs Performance Max groups based on existing feed fields.
output: Group high-margin accessories by product type and margin label.
Separate core products by brand and category.
Keep products with unresolved policy flags outside launch-ready groups.

best_practices: Provide the feed export, diagnostics, landing-page facts, platform, and campaign goal before requesting recommendations.
Verify every identifier, price, availability value, and product claim against an authoritative source.
Review flagged items before applying changes or saving the remediation package.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent GTINs, prices, stock states, categories, or claims.
Do not optimize titles before resolving disapprovals that prevent products from serving.
Do not treat estimated limits or taxonomy mappings as current platform policy without verification.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a feed export, diagnostics report, relevant landing-page facts, target platform, and campaign goal.

faq.question: Does this skill edit Merchant Center directly?
faq.answer: No. It produces a remediation package. Publishing changes requires a manual import or an approved connector workflow.

faq.question: Can it create missing GTINs?
faq.answer: No. It identifies missing or invalid GTINs and requests a verified manufacturer source.

faq.question: Which platforms does it support?
faq.answer: Its patterns cover Google Shopping, Performance Max, Meta catalogs, and Microsoft Shopping. Current platform requirements still require verification.

faq.question: Does it write search ad copy?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on product feed titles, descriptions, attributes, diagnostics, and catalog grouping.

faq.question: How does it handle unsupported claims?
faq.answer: It flags claims requiring evidence and uses approved wording when a verified claims ledger is available.
